findings.summary: Dark background with small grey text is hard to read even when enlarged, especially column headings and the small print under the filters.
The page opens with S&P 500 and index-tracking filters, so a cautious saver feels the page is not for her.
Large share returns (24%, 26%) stand out first, with no warning that they can fall.
Returns are shown before management fees, so the reader cannot tell what she would actually get.
Many rows show 'less than 3 years' instead of a return figure.
The coloured exposure circles are close in colour and not explained.
Without the filters, the reader cannot tell which tracks in the list are government bonds.
The site name 'מקור' is unfamiliar, with no bank or official name the reader recognises.
